description: This is a Java source file for the implementation of the CategoryService interface, specifically the CategoryServiceImpl class. It handles business logic related to categories within the shopizer e-commerce platform, including creation, listing, deletion, and hierarchical management of category entities.

classes.name: CategoryServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CategoryService interface, providing business logic for category management such as creation, retrieval, deletion, and hierarchy management within the application's domain.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new category, sets its lineage and depth based on its parent, then updates it in the database.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Returns a count of products associated with given categories for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories by list of codes for a store and language.

methods.name: listByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by list of IDs for a store and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its ID and associated language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new category or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories matching a specific lineage for a store.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories matching a specific lineage for a store code.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a SEO URL for a store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a category by SEO URL.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by code and store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by code and store code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a category entity by its ID.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories with the specified parent category.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Retrieves categories by store and parent category.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories by parent category and language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of a category for a specific language.

methods.name: addCategoryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a category.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child category under a parent, updating lineage and depth accordingly.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specified depth for a store.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specified depth for a store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves categories by name for a store and language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories for a store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories for a store and language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a category along with its subcategories and updates related products accordingly.
